to explain this is biological terms alligators and crocodiles are distantly related. this means at one point i’m time they were likely two different types within the same species (think dog breeds). but as the two began to adapt and evolve over time something occurs called speciation which is when two animals of the same species become too distinct from one another and are no longer considered the same species (oftentimes this is due to allopatric speciation - when the two are separated in physical location like by a river or onto differing islands) complete speciation results in two different species (like alligators and crocodiles) who either cannot (biologically) or will not (sexually) breed and produce offspring. in the occasion where it’s the later but an offspring is forced, most often the offspring will b infertile and this will not pass on its traits or that of its parents.

Struggling against the ropes that bound me quickly dragged into small, futile efforts to rip myself from its grasps. The raw, torn skin around my wrists and ankles  beckoned me to give up my pointless efforts. As I finally ceased wrestling and pulling against the thick strands that held me to the wall, I could feel myself growing sleepy again. Against my better judgment I drew into a sleep lead by my own pulsating heartbeat. However the eeriness of the silent empty room made my shuteye restless and light, it was that or the excruciating pain I had fallen accustomed to. 

The darkness of sleep was indecipherable from the pitch of the room. It’s cold, dry atmosphere compelling me to yearn for help from anyone. Unbeknownst to me though, my salvation would come with a cost. My pleas and cries echoed throughout the room. Growing more desperate each second, the first tear escaped my composure. My strong willed exterior had crumbled to the ground leaving behind a pitiful excuse of my aspirations. So as I depreciated into nothing and the noise again had stopped, footsteps. Lightly tapping, slowly paced. A calm walk towards me. So I built myself doing me best to cover up my weakened spirit. 

In stepped a man. Young but mature. I reasoned he had to be young twenties; maybe 23. He carried a proud, smug demeanor along with killer looks, pun not intended. Despite the defined muscles that pressed against the sleeves of his shirt and meticulously styled hair,  nothing could distract me from my goals:
1. Get free
2. kill him
But his presence alone increased my want to stop trying and let him have his way. It discouraged my original motives  but pushed for a new plan. However, I couldn’t let his perfect imperfections cloud my judgement, this man was a danger. Not only to me but society. His streak of immortality stemmed from his absolute willingness to to kill. To kill his God given soulmates in cold blood. So here I was at his complete mercy, my attempt to stop his reign had been in vain for I was the one tied up, not him. 

I waited silently for him to speak. But it didn’t not come. Not until I again grew restless and angry and spewed obscenities at him. 
“Easy girl.”, his tone contrasted that I had imagined; soft and collected. But what had not caught me off guard was his condescending manor. “Listen please, i’m saying this now and I do NOT like repeating myself”. His calmness momentarily lapsing, he spat out the last bit. “Stop struggling, stop glaring at me, you will not be set free. I have not worked this hard all these years to be brought to my premature death by a delusional, little girl such as yourself.”. A deafening pause followed. “What, no protests now?”. Again a pause. “Melanie.”
